'''Shola''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with constant [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] and corrosive [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]. Its core was a chamber of [[Water/Legends|icy]] gas while the outside was searing hot. The planet was also almost impossible to explore, with falling volcanic ash and dangerous [[Mining/Legends|mining]] shafts.

==History==
[[File:Shola.jpg|thumb|left|Shola after the cataclysm]]
Due to the presence of [[Shola Ruins|ancient ruins]] on the planet, many scientists believed that a [[Extinct Shola species|civilization]] once resided on Shola, but were all killed in a [[Destruction of Shola|massive cataclysm]] that left the planet in its present state. Another theory held that the original inhabitants over-mined the planet and the crust collapsed. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] crime syndicate seized the planet established racketeering operations.

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Unused information in MasterTextFile.dat in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'' indicate that Shola was originally planned to be where [[Tyber Zann]] hid Jabba's [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], and that there would be a mission to smuggle it off-planet, but this content was cut from the final release.
